{{Top|ga|audio=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=hI2K8AnbhnU}} {{Nickname}} {{Character |type= |image=[[File:Gani.png]] |name=Gani |homeworld= |birth= |death= |species=[[Human]]{{Andor|Kassa (episode)}} |gender= |pronouns= |height= |mass= |hair=[[Color|Black]] |feathers= |eyes= |skin=Dark |cyber= |families= |parents= |partners= |siblings= |children= |affiliation=[[Leisure Zone brothel]] |masters= |apprentices= }} {{Quote|Hello, guys.|Gani addresses Kravas Drezzer and Verlo Skiff|audio=Gani-Andor1.flac|}} '''Gani''' was the name used by a [[human]] hostess at a [[Leisure Zone]] [[Leisure Zone brothel|brothel]] on the [[planet]] [[Morlana One]]. In [[5 BBY]], Gani conversed with the [[Consolidated Holdings of Preox-Morlana Corporation|Preox-Morlana]] sentries [[Corporal]] [[Kravas Drezzer]] and [[Verlo Skiff]] at the establishment's bar after the pair complained that another [[Unidentified brothel hostess|hostess]] had approached the patron [[Cassian Jeron Andor|Cassian Andor]] before them. ==Biography== {{Quote|We've been waiting. He just got here.''"
"''Gani will help you."''
"''I don't want Gani."''
"''Behave.|Verlo Skiff and one of Gani's colleagues|audio=Skiff-Hostess-Andor1.flac|}} [[File:GaniAndSentries.png|thumb|right|300px|Gani spoke with Kravas Drezzer and Verlo Skiff at the brothel.]] Gani was the name used by a hostess who worked at an [[Leisure Zone brothel|expensive brothel]] in the [[Leisure Zone]] on the [[planet]] [[Morlana One]], although no one used their real names at the establishment. During a somewhat quiet [[Standard day|night]] in [[5 BBY]], another [[Unidentified brothel hostess|hostess]] at the brothel approached the patron [[Cassian Jeron Andor|Cassian Andor]] shortly after he arrived. This caused [[Corporal]] [[Kravas Drezzer]] and [[Verlo Skiff]], a pair of [[Consolidated Holdings of Preox-Morlana Corporation|Preox-Morlana]] sentries, to complain, as they had been waiting longer and wished to be served first. The other hostess told them that Gani would tend to them, but when they complained that they did not want Gani, she told them to behave. Gani then approached the pair and conversed with them briefly at the bar before departing without them. Soon after, the two sentries followed Andor out of the brothel and were [[Death|killed]] by him, prompting a Preox-Morlana investigation. ==Personality and traits== Gani was a [[Color|dark]]-skinned [[human]] with black [[hair]]. ==Equipment== While working, Gani wore a red [[Clothing|dress]] with golden jewelry including a [[necklace]], bracelets, and hoop [[Piercing|earrings]]. ==Behind the scenes== Gani was portrayed by [[Latesha Wilson]] in "[[Kassa (episode)|Kassa]]," the first episode of the [[Disney+]] television series ''[[Star Wars: Andor]]''{{'s}} [[Andor Season 1|first season]], which aired on [[September 21]], [[2022]].{{SWYouTube|cKOegEuCcfw|Andor | Official Trailer | Disney+ (2:25)|sw_url=video/andor-official-trailer}} Wilson previously portrayed characters in the [[2017]] film [[Star Wars: Episode VIII The Last Jedi|''Star Wars'': Episode VIII ''The Last Jedi'']]{{Film|VIII}} and the [[2019]] film [[Star Wars: Episode IX The Rise of Skywalker|''Star Wars'': Episode IX ''The Rise of Skywalker'']].{{Film|IX}} ==Appearances== {{Mediacat|imagecat=Images of Gani|audiocat=Audio files of Gani}} *{{Andor|Kassa (episode)}} {{1st}} ==Notes and references== {{Reflist}} {{Interlang |de=Gani |es=Gani |fr=Gani |ja=ガニ |ka=განი |nl=Gani |pl=Gani }} [[Category:Humans]] [[Category:Individuals of unspecified gender]] [[Category:Individuals with unspecified pronouns]] [[Category:Prostitutes]]
